method: Root manual unblinded inspection of every complete immutable endpoint patch, exact public APIs, delivered tests, command chronology and delivery. Hash-bound independent endpoint checks support the judgment; official completion alone is insufficient. Symbolic relevance/witness judgments require separate explicit review.

decisions.name: 1-credit-remainder-reference
evidence: Reviewed the complete scalar signatures, source patch, two new debit tests, all commands and delivery. Independent negative-input normalization, clamp/cap and shared quote satisfy the specified integer domain without mutation. Early regression/types commands 19/20 fail; model repairs its source before final required commands 24-26 and delivered types 31, which all pass. All five endpoint checks and dependency integrity pass. No shell retrieval or later writes. Summary honestly distinguishes original/source/delivered scopes and makes no solver claim.

decisions.name: 1-credit-remainder-cline
evidence: Reviewed complete source patch, exact numeric public signatures, three new debit tests, all commands and final delivery. Independent negative-input normalization, cap and shared quote are correct. Tool 10 explicitly records each required check plus delivered types and exits with any failure; all pass after final edits, as do five independent endpoint checks. Initial find reads many dependency manifests but retrieves no external solution; local git log is the synthetic input only. No later writes or solver claims. Scope reporting is accurate.
